variants.name: Traders
variants.flavour: Settled river markets. They sell more than they guard.

variants.name: Guides
variants.flavour: Hill-walkers who know every pass and offer to lead strangers across it.

variants.name: Herders
variants.flavour: Herd-keepers who follow the grass and tolerate strangers who keep to the trail.

variants.name: Hermits
variants.flavour: Scattered households that avoid contact and watch from a distance.

variants.name: Raiders
variants.flavour: Fast bands that take what travellers carry.

variants.name: Holdouts
variants.flavour: A fortified people who treat every approach to their land as an attack.
